title: Legal Forwarding Agreements Matter Reporting and Closure Timetable
content:
Three time periods of the Legal Forwarding Agreements are set per programme and run on each forwarded matter: the interval between matter status reports to the creditor client, the calendar days after a judgment is paid within which the satisfaction is filed with the court, and the months after judgment with no recovery after which a matter is closed uncollectible.

## Timetable

| Programme | Status report interval | Satisfaction filed after a judgment is paid | Closed uncollectible after judgment with no recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | every 30 days | 0 days | 0 months |
| Small Claims Suit Program | every 30 days | within 30 days | 12 months |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | every 30 days | within 30 days | 24 months |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | every 30 days | within 30 days | 24 months |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | every 30 days | within 30 days | 36 months |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | every 15 days | within 30 days | 36 months |

## What the periods measure

- **Status report interval** — the calendar days between matter status reports to the client. Every programme reports every 30 calendar days except the Full-Service Litigation Program, which reports every 15.
- **Satisfaction filing** — the calendar days after a judgment is paid within which the satisfaction is filed with the court: 30 under every programme that takes judgments. The Attorney Demand Program shows 0, as it files no suits.
- **Uncollectible closure** — the months after judgment with no recovery after which a matter is closed uncollectible; 0 where no judgments are taken, as under the Attorney Demand Program. The period is 12 months under the Small Claims Suit Program, 24 months under the Client-Advanced Cost and Agency-Advanced Cost Suit programmes, and 36 months under the Judgment Enforcement Program and the Full-Service Litigation Program.

## Sample readings (hypothetical matters)

| Programme | Hypothetical situation | Period that applies |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Litigation Program | an open matter | status reports every 15 calendar days |
| Small Claims Suit Program | a judgment paid in full | satisfaction filed with the court within 30 calendar days of payment |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | a judgment with no recovery for 24 months after it | 24 months reached for uncollectible closure |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | a judgment with no recovery for 24 months after it | short of the 36 months for uncollectible closure |
